title: Sprint 4: Tools department normalization & capability reuse
originalPrompt:
# LANDOS SPRINT 4 — TOOLS DEPARTMENT NORMALIZATION & CAPABILITY REUSE

The same research capabilities that now work automatically from New Lead / Deal Card must also work cleanly and independently from the LandOS Tools department. Deal Cards consume capabilities; they do not own them. One capability, multiple callers.

PRODUCT OUTCOME: The operator can open Tools and independently invoke useful LandOS research capabilities against a property or market without creating a New Lead first: resolve a property, run LandPortal research, Government/Zoning & Planning research, Public Records/Assessor research, Comp/Valuation research, County Market Research, ZIP Market Research, Market Pulse, and other existing registered capabilities where appropriate. The available set comes from the actual capability registry. No duplicate "Tools versions" of capabilities; Tools calls the SAME underlying capability contracts used by the Deal Card mission.

CORE RULE — ONE CAPABILITY, MULTIPLE CALLERS. No ToolsLandPortal/DealCardLandPortal splits, no separate evidence pipelines for Tools.

NORMALIZE THE CAPABILITY MANIFEST: use the existing registry as the authoritative manifest. Each operator-usable capability should expose: id, operator-facing name, description, prerequisites, input shape, output type, availability, manual invocability, whether it writes authoritative evidence, whether it can run without a Deal, associated Skill, governed recovery behavior. Extend the existing contract only if a tiny extension is necessary; never a second registry.

PREREQUISITE-AWARE TOOLS: consume Sprint 1 prerequisite semantics. County Market Research requires county (not parcel). ZIP Market Research requires ZIP. Market Pulse requires county. LandPortal parcel research requires established subject. The UI must not disable everything because an APN is not officially verified, and must not launch a capability whose genuine prerequisites are absent; communicate missing prerequisites plainly.

TOOL INPUT: simplest useful operator input (address, APN, county, ZIP, owner, LandPortal URL, existing Deal/property selection). Reuse existing Smart Intake/property-resolution parsing and shared Subject State mechanisms. Do not duplicate the New Lead workflow inside Tools.

PROPERTY CONTEXT MODES: support (a) existing LandOS property/Deal — consume canonical Subject State and retained evidence; (b) standalone research input — run without creating a lead; no junk sales leads, no parallel shadow property system.

LANDPORTAL TOOL: deterministic workflow → validate outputs → existing governed recovery → structured result/evidence. Navigation success alone is not completion.

GOVERNMENT/ZONING TOOL: existing Skill and deterministic source race; zoning, uses, MH eligibility, setbacks, minimums, overlays, subdivision rules, official sources, unresolved requirements. Deterministic official-source research first; bounded recovery only after genuine insufficiency; no guessed zoning.

PUBLIC RECORDS/ASSESSOR TOOL: deterministic adapters/official retrieval first → validate → at most one governed specialist recovery where justified → subject-match validation → evidence admission. Show the final useful result, not agent internals.

COMP/VALUATION TOOL: same Skill/collectors as Deal Card. Returned candidates ≠ accepted comps. Show candidates found, accepted, exclusion reasons, resulting valuation or valuation-pending. No invented FMV.

MARKET TOOLS: surface County Market Research, ZIP Market Research, Market Pulse from existing capabilities; no parcel requirement where prerequisites do not demand one; easy to run independently; no new market engines.

EVIDENCE/RESULT: manual runs use the accepted shared contracts. Deal-associated runs enter the SAME authoritative evidence path (subject scope, provenance, source, run identity, confidence, verification, status). Standalone exploratory runs must not silently mutate a Deal.

RUN IDENTITY/CANCELLATION: use the durable run infrastructure accepted in Sprint 1. Honest running state, refresh/rejoin where supported, respect cancellation, reject late writes.

RESULT VOCABULARY: canonical Sprint 1 result states; operator language may be friendlier but semantics map to the same contract.

SKILLS: invoke the Sprint 2 LandOS-native skills (LandPortal Research; Government/Zoning & Planning; Public Records Research/Recovery; Comp/Valuation Research). No duplicate Tools skills.

UI SCOPE — SMALL: only enough Tools-page work to make capabilities discoverable, understandable, manually invocable, prerequisite-aware, and able to show current/result state. Preserve existing design language. No redesign (that is the next sprint). Conceptually distinguish Capabilities/Tools, Skills, Specialists; a simple operator-facing capability catalog is enough.

ACCEPTANCE (live Tools department, not just unit tests):
- CASE A: property resolution + LandPortal research without a New Lead.
- CASE B: one representative official-research capability (government/public records) manually; deterministic-first; correct result admission.
- CASE C: County Market Research and/or Market Pulse with geography alone; no parcel prerequisite incorrectly imposed.
- CASE D: comp research manually; returned-vs-accepted semantics intact.
- CASE E: existing accepted Deal selected; capability run from Tools consumes the same canonical Subject State without reinterpreting identity.
- CROSS-CALLER: for at least one capability, automatic Deal Card invocation and manual Tools invocation use the same capability implementation, Skill/procedure, prerequisite contract, and evidence/result semantics.

DO NOT REGRESS SPRINTS 1–3: 5/5 cold-lead autonomy, canonical Subject State, subjectResolved vs officiallyVerified, prerequisite-driven parallelism, LandPortal URL resolution, messy APN normalization, provider vs official evidence separation, strict comp acceptance, no fabricated FMV/zoning, durable run ownership, cancellation, evidence admission, readiness semantics, refresh-safe state, no duplicate assessor/zoning recovery loops. Focused regression over these seams; full five-lead matrix only if a change genuinely affects New Lead.

NOT IN SCOPE: global UI/UX redesign, design-system agents, Seller Call Prep, Daily Briefing, Pipeline Commander, Finance/TC, Strategy/War Council, Jarvis/Max, Forge, external MCP expansion.

TESTING: focused registry tests, Tools routes/API tests, prerequisite tests, evidence/run/result-contract tests, skill/governance validation, typecheck, production build, managed runtime, live Tools browser acceptance. Do not hide baseline failures; internal defects are work, not blockers.

GIT: one writable session; preserve unrelated untracked files; no secrets, paid APIs, or deploy. After acceptance: final focused regression, build/typecheck, live acceptance, inspect diff, commit, push, verify remote, stop. Do not begin the UI sprint automatically.

Finish exactly: LANDOS_SPRINT_COMPLETE: PASS (or LANDOS_SPRINT_BLOCKED: <exact external blocker> only for genuine external impossibility).
